ideas.pitch: A multilingual AI triage and health awareness platform designed for semi-urban and rural populations.
ideas.title: RuralPulse Health AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses real-world social impact by combining localized healthcare access with multilingual support, a proven winning formula from similar health-tech hackathon victories.

ideas.pitch: An autonomous data pipeline incident response agent that diagnoses pipeline failures and opens verified pull requests.
ideas.title: DataGuard Incident Auto-Fixer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates genuinely hard engineering by automating complex backend data engineering workflows, mirroring past data platform hackathon grand prize winners.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered multi-agent platform for tracking, optimizing, and reducing campus-wide carbon footprints and resource waste.
ideas.title: EcoNav Green Campus Platform
ideas.why_it_could_win: Features clear measurable environmental impact and leverages multi-agent orchestrations which consistently score high with technical judges.

ideas.pitch: A real-time BERT-powered spam and phishing detection system for calls, SMS, and emails with an interactive dashboard.
ideas.title: SecureGuard Spam & Phishing Shield
ideas.why_it_could_win: Relies on a live, highly demonstrable prototype that immediately solves a ubiquitous security problem under tight time constraints.

ideas.pitch: A systematic benchmarking harness evaluating prompt and architecture strategies using chess decision-making as a proxy task.
ideas.title: QuantChess Strategy Benchmarker
ideas.why_it_could_win: Showcases advanced algorithmic evaluation and hard systems engineering that stands out among standard web app submissions.
